title: Understanding Linear Combinations
text: Think about what it means for a vector to be a linear combination of other vectors. How are the coefficients involved in forming this combination?

title: Exploring the Model Structure
text: Consider the structure of Wesley's model: $$y_{hat,i}=\theta_0+\theta_1 {x_{i1}}^3+\theta_2 \ln\left(x_{i2}\right)$$. How does this relate to the concept of linearity in terms of the parameters?

title: Identifying Linear Combinations
text: Which of the following statements is true about linear combinations?
choices: A linear combination can include $$non-linear$$ transformations like powers and logarithms.
A linear combination involves only addition and scalar multiplication of vectors.

title: Analyzing the Model's Linearity
text: Does the presence of $${x_{i1}}^3$$ and $$\ln\left(x_{i2}\right)$$ affect the linearity of the model in terms of the parameters?
choices: No, the model remains linear in terms of the parameters.
Yes, it makes the model $$non-linear$$ in terms of the parameters.
